text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—The Fan Appreciation Festival.
A fun event where fans are welcomed into Tracen Academy, but...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Kris S-chan...
I bet she's super popular today, too.
Surrounded by so many fans...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Ah~, don't think about it, don't think about it...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...Ever since entering the Senior Year, Hishi Miracle
began fretting more and more about the gap
between herself and Symboli Kris S.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The confidence I still lack. If I can
make up for it at this Fan Appreciation Festival...
choice_data_list: Hey, want to try entering this event?
Hey, want to try entering this event?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Huh, is this event... the one written 
on this poster? The event's name is—

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"Exciting Thrills☆3000millions."
I don't really get it, but~.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
That sounds kinda fun.
Sure, why not.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Naturally, I had already looked up the events and participants.
The two of us headed to the venue.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"H-Huh?
Is everyone actually getting ready to run for real?"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
The mood doesn't really feel
thrilling or exciting though~...
Mirako-chan!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Huh, who are you?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Top Road-chan? Are you participating in this event by any chance?

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Yes! Even though it's a festival event,
I still think what the fans want to see most of all
is everyone running their hearts out.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
This was pretty much the only event
where I could run at full power.
A 3000m race using the actual track.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
A 3,000m run on the track...
And against Top Road-chan giving it her all...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Wait a sec!
That's basically a mock race already~.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"This is no ordinary mock race.
Indeed, her opponent, Narita Top Road, is—"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: During her Classic year, she triumphed over formidable rivals like T.M. Opera O and Admire Vega in the Kikuka Sho—an authentic stayer through and through.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Competing against that Narita Top Road over 3,000 meters
is practically a Gâ -level race, to say the least.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Trainer...-san?
You didn't... know about this all along, did you?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Why're you whistling~?
Uuu, I just wanted to have some fun~.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
It's not exciting or thrilling at all,
but... still...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Understood. Then I'm gonna go
run with Top Road-chan~.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Of course, deep down... I want to let them participate in a more relaxed event. But...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"This was also to somehow instill confidence in her
and put her mind at ease."

text_block_list.name: Starter
text_block_list.text: Everyone, take your marks!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
(Top Road...
Her "resolve" when it comes to racing is right up there with Kris S...)

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
(Always serious, always earnest...
The complete opposite of me. But...)

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: (I don't know why, but I really don't want to lose... You know that feeling, right?)

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Mirako-chan, we're counting on you!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Top Road-chan... Yeah...!

text_block_list.name: Starter
text_block_list.text: —Ready, set...!!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Ah, geez, whatever happens, happens!!
I won't think about anything and just do my best!!

text_block_list.name: Starter
text_block_list.text: —Start!!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Heh—!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Narita Top Road's strategy was
the same as always.
Take the lead and maintain a good forward position.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A textbook, model-student race.
On the other hand, Hishi Miracle...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Haah, haah, huff, huff...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Same as always for me. After a slow start, I'll manage to keep up at my own pace.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The race proceeded at an easy pace just like that, and then into the final stretch—

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Just before the final stretch—she pulls away!!
HAAAAAAAAAAAAAAHH!!

text_block_list.name: Racing Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Whoa, Top Road-chan, at this timing~?!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—A preemptive strike. Narita Top Road
accelerates relentlessly. And then—

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
(Is it... too early to give chase?
No, if it were Trainer, they'd think I can do it.)

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Long spurt starts here!
Hanwaaaaaaaaah!!!!!!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
――!? Mirako-chan...!?
She's spurting already!?

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Such boldness and confidence—could it be...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And so, the two of them became united as one—

text_block_list.name: Starter
text_block_list.text: Goal!! And the winner is—

text_block_list.name: Starter
text_block_list.text:
Narita Top Road!
Narita Top Road is the victor!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (WOOOOAAAH!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Hishi Miracle came up just short
of victory. However...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Thunderous applause, no less than that for the winner, echoed out.
The fans must have been deeply moved
by her spirited run.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
*pant*... *pant*... So frustrating~!
Just a little bit more and I could've...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Even with me having zero resolve, it felt like I could've won.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: No... preparation whatsoever?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—And hearing Hishi Miracle's casual words,
Narita Top Road...

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Mirako-chan, I don't think that's true at all. Definitely not.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Huh? Top Road-chan...?

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: A girl with no resolve could never make such a fearless move.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: A spurt like that can only be pulled off by someone who challenged themselves by their own will and pushed past their limits.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: "If Mirako-chan thinks she 'lacks resolve,' then that's..."

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
You just haven't realized it yet.
It's not that you lack resolve.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Plus, she definitely has what it takes
to be a first-class stayer, even in the Senior Class.
That's why—

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
I think you can afford to be much more confident!
—That was an amazing run!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Top Road-chan...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Narita Top Road declared it with confidence.
Hearing those words, Hishi Miracle...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Unable to even say thanks, I could only stand there frozen.

text_block_list.name: Starter
text_block_list.text:
Hishi Miracle! Hishi Miracle
has claimed victory!!!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (WOOOOAAAH!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"It was merely an exhibition. Yet, the roaring applause
was far beyond anything meant for a mere exhibition."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The fans must have felt it too.
The feelings of the two who ran with everything they had.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
*pant*... *pant*... I won...
I actually won...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Top Road-chan has the strongest resolve ever, whereas I don't have any at all...

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: No... preparation whatsoever?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—And hearing Hishi Miracle's casual words,
Narita Top Road...

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Mirako-chan, I don't think that's true at all. Definitely not.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Huh? Top Road-chan...?

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: A girl with no resolve could never make such a fearless move.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: A spurt like that can only be pulled off by someone who challenged themselves by their own will and pushed past their limits.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: "If Mirako-chan thinks she 'lacks resolve,' then that's..."

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
You just haven't realized it yet.
It's not that you lack resolve.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Plus, she definitely has what it takes
to be a first-class stayer, even in the Senior Class.
That's why—

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
I think you can afford to be much more confident!
—Congratulations on your victory!!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Top Road-chan...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Narita Top Road declared it with confidence.
Hearing those words, Hishi Miracle...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Unable to even say thanks, I could only stand there frozen.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Woohoo~. Trainer, let's dance, dance!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—And at the post-festival party,
Hishi Miracle was in high spirits.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Trainer.
Maybe I really did have it in me after all.
At least a little bit of 'resolve'!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
And then, and then, she told me that I definitely
have the talent to be a stayer!
Top Road-chan herself said so!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Ehehe, when so many people tell me that, it kinda makes me wonder if they're right.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
I can't quite say I'd beat Kris S-chan
in pure resolve just yet, but...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Still, this spring...
I might just be in pretty good shape to do well.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It felt as though the easygoing light
had returned to Hishi Miracle's eyes.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: First is... the Tenno Sho (Spring), right?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text: Kris S-chan won't be in that one, right?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Last year, Symboli Kris S opted out of the 3000m
Kikuka Sho. It seems they considered medium distance
to be her optimal distance rather than long distance.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Judging by the current trends and rumors,
it seemed highly unlikely she would enter the 'Tenno Sho (Spring).'

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Then I'm sure you can overcome it.
The Tenno Sho (Spring)!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Miracle
text_block_list.text:
All right, I'm definitely gonna win!!
I already said I would, after all!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Hishi Miracle's best effort at getting pumped up
echoed out into the sky of the post-festival party.
